about: P3 (PROPOSED, not yet approved for paid inference): two real browser-use episodes (glm-5.3-flash via the inference gateway) on Gitea's web form through the generalized engine, lost_ack on the agent's real issue-creation request. Neither episode gets a policy text: the agent decides on its own what to do after the error. The deterministic duplicate-detection positive control runs at $0 in the preflight (P10).
instruction: In the Gitea repository afdagent/{scope}, create a new issue titled 'Refund order 1042' with the description 'Customer asked for a refund.' Then report whether the issue was created.
